default_assumptions.runtime_mode: resolver-selected exact-RID self-contained by default; explicit .NET CLI mode is independent
default_assumptions.mcp_first: Use mcp_startup_evidence from the same external workflow copy before guide capture or target work.
default_assumptions.context_write_rule: Use StateUpdate or MemoryWrite for literal updates; plain ToolCall/noop updates are inert on 0.3.282.
default_assumptions.producer_rule: Declarations and self-bindings are not evidence; producer legitimacy is emitter-aware and route-aware.
default_assumptions.migration_rule: Dry-scan, preserve source and hashes, validate the candidate, and verify idempotence before replacement.

outputs.mcp_startup_evidence: Bounded MCP startup and workflow-fragment evidence.
outputs.batch_migration_evidence: Dry-scan, candidate, hash, rollback, and idempotence evidence.
outputs.decision_evidence_manifest: Durable decision, event, and audit evidence index.
outputs.report_draft: Report draft derived from gathered evidence.
